pathAssistantSteps.info: Fresh inbound — speed wins. Review the Lead Quality card before outreach (fit, duplicates, entitlement for existing accounts). First touch within 4 working hours — the routing SLA. Set Next Step and Next Contact Date as soon as you take the record.
Actively engaging. Keep Next Step and Next Contact Date current — the reminder-task engine works off them. Log every call and email so the timeline tells the story.
Interested, not ready. Set a realistic Next Contact Date (2–4 week cadence) and note what would change their timing. Don't let nurture records go dark.
This field will be updated automatically when the Lead is converted and an Opportunity is created. Work the Opportunity from here — Date Completed stamps itself.
Pick the Reason Disqualified that fits best — it feeds form-quality reporting back to Marketing. Use the Disqualify action for a guided close-out; Date Completed stamps automatically.
